### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, touching **10** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-ui.ts`, `packages/mcp/README.md`, `packages/mcp/server.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**7** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/install-modes.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE))_
- `content/docs/deployment/marketplace-handbook.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE))_
- `content/docs/getting-started/examples.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE))_
- `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx`  _(via group_overview (literal, a string literal in navigationContributions))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE))_
- `content/docs/protocol/kernel/plugin-spec.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE))_
- `content/docs/ui/apps.mdx`  _(via navigationContributions (symbol, a field of const object CONNECT_AGENT_UI_BUNDLE), group_integrations (literal, a string literal in navigationContributions), group_overview (literal, a string literal in navigationContributions))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-ui.ts`, `packages/mcp/README.md`, `packages/mcp/server.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **159** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **159**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **104** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **46** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `6d5a209e34269add828f03a85455fafe0360f948` — the merge of head `34e848007a6d58b2b4dc643a168dfcf15ed5d4c1` into base `33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 6d5a209e34269add828f03a85455fafe0360f948 && git checkout 6d5a209e34269add828f03a85455fafe0360f948
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36 34e848007a6d58b2b4dc643a168dfcf15ed5d4c1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36 && git merge --no-ff 34e848007a6d58b2b4dc643a168dfcf15ed5d4c1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 33043bd8a2b34ed2efdc188f38173c1c44ca3f36` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-06T13:31Z · head `34e848007a6d58b2b4dc643a168dfcf15ed5d4c1`

Seat `domain:ui#2` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6683345034 on #30895, card thread `session_01L9qibz5UZefuR7CExjD9VX`, report 6684842607). The same seat dispatched and reviews; the code is the thread's.

1. **Shape:** 38 files, +299 / -104. The page, its `page:header` and both nav entries are renamed Connect an AI Assistant in four platform locales; the source digests are re-recorded. `ACCOUNT_APP` declares the empty, expanded slot `grp_account_ai_assistant` after Inbox, and the MCP account contribution targets it. The Setup contribution moves from `group_integrations` to `group_overview` at priority 110. Both groups carry `manage_platform_settings`, so who sees it is unchanged. `AppHeader` draws an avatar-menu item under Profile only while the served Account app's navigation carries a `connect_agent` page entry (`navCarriesPage`), so it disappears with MCP off. `user.connectAiAssistant` ships in ten console locales. The page address and item id are unchanged. `Part of #30895`: Expected 1, 4 and 5.
2. **Premise measured:** live on `main` `7d9682ff` and on the branch, as an admin and as a member (per report): Setup moved from the 8th group, entry 42 of 45, to Overview, entry 2. Account moved from the collapsed Developer group to its own expanded group. The avatar menu gains the item. A member's Setup access is unchanged.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** 65 check runs on this head, 58 success, 7 skipped, 0 red. 100 derived gates were run and reconciled with `--ran` on `0264ecd7`. The ablation of the page gate reds the MCP-off case. The delta `0264ecd7..34e84800` is one commit, `AppHeader.tsx` ±6. It is the seat-review fix: the two new declarations are moved above the typing-target JSDoc, so that block documents `isTypingTarget` again. The AppHeader test file passed 8/8 and the app-shell type-check exited 0 on the new head.
4. **Accepted deviation:** the seat extended the surface to name and path wording only, in `packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/keys.ts`, `packages/mcp/server.json`, `packages/mcp/README.md` and five docs pages. The two comment-only header edits in `cloud-connection-ui.ts` and `connector-credentials-ui.ts` are also accepted. The flagged docs-drift pages were each read, and none was made false.
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** none filed. `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`'s palette label is left alone, because #30896–#30898 hold that file. `Metadata-protocol: none`; `Skills-docs:` not owed.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --branch` on the final list: 0 of 38 paths governed and 403 changed lines, so Tier S, with no human approval owed. `Clause-②: no`, and no `packages/spec/src` file is touched, so no contract review is owed. Landing on the maintainer's standing words 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (2026-10-30T14:20Z) and 「ui 车道跟进一下 3小时内没更新的pr和已派发的issue，接手处理。」 (2026-11-06T05:20Z): relay `pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`. On merge the card stays open for part 2 (Expected 2 and 3, after #30894).
